packageRules.description: Tier 1 — Stable: group all patch updates from low-risk packages into a single weekly PR
Tier 2 — Control-plane / CRD-sensitive: 7-day stability, separate PRs, needs-review label
Tier 3 — Stateful workloads: patches only; disable minor and major auto-PRs (postgres/loki/valkey require migration planning)

Tier 4 — Alpha (kagent charts + image, kmcp): block all auto-PRs; bump manually after reading release notes. Matches the kagent + kagent-crds helm charts at ghcr.io/kagent-dev/kagent/helm/* as well as the runtime image and kmcp.

Tier 5 — First-party apps (n2solutionsio/*): immediate auto-PR, no stability gate, never grouped, needs-review label. We control these releases and test them ourselves before tagging; the 7-day Tier 2 wait is friction without value. Each release gets its own PR. `schedule: at any time` overrides the global Monday-only schedule so Renovate opens our own bump PRs as soon as Mend's hosted runner sees the new tag on ghcr.
Tag major updates for extra scrutiny across all tiers
